title: Defensive M2S: Training Guardrail Models on Compressed Multi-turn Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for improving the efficiency of safety classifiers (guardrails). While the goal is to prevent unethical or harmful outputs, the work itself does not evaluate or benchmark moral frameworks or ethical principles. It treats safety as a technical classification problem (safe/unsafe) based on existing datasets and taxonomies of harm, rather than investigating the nature of ethics itself.
